verdict.rationale: stagewise lets users review and roll back what agents do: inline and side-by-side diff review, accept/reject, and per-action undo/redo of agent edits. Its reusable workflows exist as SKILL.md files and slash commands. However, nothing shows versioning, review, or rollback of the automations themselves; the controls apply to agent output, not to automation definitions. missing for 10: versioning/history of skills or automations, review workflow for automation changes, rollback of automation definitions, independent corroboration.
